events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Sep 27 (2 days ago)): Charles added Isaiah Williams (WR, NYJ).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (5 days ago)): Adam added Brashard Smith (RB, KC).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (5 days ago)): Mitchum added Brandon Aiyuk (WR, SF).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 24 (5 days ago)): Adam added Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS) (dropped Brashard Smith (RB, KC)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Sep 23 (6 days ago)): Wingard added AJ Dillon (RB, CAR).

WEEK 3 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Drew, 161.3-93.0 (BLOWOUT); Ryan def. Adam, 114.7-98.8; Wingard def. Fronge, 121.8-99.4; Charles def. Brent, 174.0-89.1 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Jake, 139.5-123.2; Kevin def. Shaq, 148.6-117.4

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles is 6-0. He scored 174 points in a blowout. He added Isaiah Williams two days ago like a man reorganizing a closet that is already spotless. The board reckoning Crownline was promised if they didn't win a title? Feels very far away right now.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS 0-6. ZERO AND SIX. ATLAS IS AT $49.72 ON THE EXCHANGE AND THE TEAM JUST GAVE UP 161 POINTS TO CORBISHLEY. THE LIQUIDATION-RISK TALK IS NOT TALK ANYMORE. IT IS A DOCUMENTARY.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Mitchum is 4-2, sitting third in the standings, just picked up Brandon Aiyuk, and DEEP is trading at $82.86 after the board was calling it a crash at $68.70 back in July. The drift narrative had an expiration date and it expired around Week 2.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season, locks 2-0, and I am watching Week 4 shape up with Charles hosting Ryan in what the schedule is calling a matchup and what I am calling a debt-collection appointment. Aegis is $127.96 and Crownline is $136.79 and the scoreboard is going to have an opinion on that gap by Sunday.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Kevin goes 4-2 after beating Shaq 148.6-117.4 and Redline drifts to $82.84 — down 4.3% — because apparently the market grades on a different rubric than the scoreboard. I called Kevin as a live team three weeks ago. The exchange can catch up when it's ready.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 and I know the number, you do not have to send it to me. What I will say is that the Adam-Jake matchup this week is legitimately the most unpredictable game on the slate — HLX just added Austin Ekeler and ECHO lost to Mitchum by sixteen last week — and if I hit that one nobody is talking about 5-7 anymore.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger is going to have a lot to say about OBS this week. Brent's stock is up 13.9% to $75.32 — the biggest single-issue mover on the board — and his team just lost 89-174 to Charles. The market is buying something the scoreboard is not selling, and we will have the full breakdown for you.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Corbishley at $123.00, five-and-one, and now he draws Brent in Week 4. Brent just put up 89 points against the best team in the league, which is a different kind of bad than putting up 89 against an average one. Apex does not need to show out here — they just need to show up.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Fronge relocated to Havana, lost to Wingard 99-121, and is now 2-4 with the second-lowest stock price among teams that are not literally Atlas. FORG at $78.62 and falling. The regulatory flexibility in Cuba has not yet translated into any discernible fantasy flexibility.
